summary: The operator-remediation experiment executed (receipt 81163da076c64417bd48e0f79260d73d) and all four comparisons scored as predicted: the flagged simultaneous restart left every voter empty with no leader (violated, witness 1, staged commit indices [11 11 11]), stopping the same three nodes and restarting them on the same stores with the flag disabled restored all three configurations and produced a leader (holds at index 2, leader index 1), and the control mode was unchanged (index 4). That bounds the headline progress loss: it is in-memory and reversible by an ordinary restart with no durable state discarded and no configuration change required, though nothing in-protocol can repair it while it lasts. The parent interpretation now cites the receipt, replaces the pending note with the executed result and records the remediation as counterevidence that limits the impact rather than the finding, and the repair Fact gains the same receipt as an evidence supplement with an explicit empty-premise explanation that no wording, condition or source changed.
